definitions.explanation: Full of energy and activity. Used to describe people who are energetic, discussions that are lively, or activities and phenomena that are vigorous and ongoing.

examples.japanese: {活発|かっぱつ}な⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{活発|かっぱつ}な⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧だった。
examples.english: She has had an energetic personality since childhood.

examples.japanese: ⟦{火山|かざん}→火山：04020_kazan⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{活発|かっぱつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧、⟦{周辺|しゅうへん}→周辺：09896_shuuhen⟧⟦{住民|じゅうみん}→住民：03281_juumin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{避難|ひなん}{勧告|かんこく}→避難勧告：16642_hinankankoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|だ}された→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: Volcanic activity became vigorous, and an evacuation advisory was issued to nearby residents.

notes:
USAGE:
{活発|かっぱつ} describes energetic, vigorous activity. It can modify people (an energetic child), abstract activities (a lively debate), or natural phenomena (vigorous volcanic activity). Compare with ⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧ (healthy, energetic), which focuses on personal well-being, while {活発|かっぱつ} emphasizes dynamic activity and can apply to non-human subjects.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {活発|かっぱつ}な⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧: lively discussion
- {活発|かっぱつ}な⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧: an active/energetic child
- {活発|かっぱつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be actively involved
- {活発|かっぱつ}な⟦{火山|かざん}→火山：04020_kazan⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧: vigorous volcanic activity
- {活発|かっぱつ}な⟦{取引|とりひき}→取引：04700_torihiki⟧: brisk trading
